component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
' m.inTask is true only in the task thread's m; the render thread keeps a clone where it is false. sub init() m.top.functionName = "work" m.inTask = false m.top.observeField("initObsTaskWrite", "onObserved") end sub
sub onObserved(event as object) print "OBSERVER " + event.getField() + "=" + event.getData().toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() end sub
sub work() m.inTask = true port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("runObsTaskWrite", "onObserved") m.top.observeField("runObsRenderWrite", "onObserved") m.top.observeField("report", port) m.top.initObsTaskWrite = 1 m.top.runObsTaskWrite = 2 m.top.sceneObsTaskWrite = 4 m.top.ready = true wait(1500, port) m.top.report = "done" end sub
